pricing.billingNote: Free podcast RSS feed and Podbean web player.
pricing.freeTierNote: ~2,400 crime, mystery, and western episodes available via RSS.

provenance.primaryMasterSource: Collector MP3 transfers with host spoken intros
provenance.airdateMethodology: Collector log dates cited in episode titles and host intro
provenance.castAttributionMethod: Occasional lead actor mention in show notes; no structured character schema

specNotes.podcast_rss: Single chronological podcast feed (~3,400 episodes) with host commentary.

primary_source_verification.summary: Uses OTRR and collector log dates; generally reliable on 1950s CBS crime shows but lacks primary newspaper citations.
primary_source_verification.evidenceQuote: "Post titles include air date and episode number drawn from collector logs."

cast_credit_accuracy.summary: Host mentions starring actors verbally, without structured per-episode cast/character metadata.
cast_credit_accuracy.evidenceQuote: "Show notes list series title, episode title, and air date without structured cast tables."

vtt_transcripts.evidenceQuote: "MP3 podcast enclosures only; no `.vtt` caption files."

master_provenance.summary: Selects clean collector transfers (64–128 kbps MP3), though original disc lineage is not recorded.
master_provenance.evidenceQuote: "Standardized 64–128 kbps MP3 podcast encodes hosted on Podbean CDN."

serial_continuity.summary: Frequently posts complete 5-part *Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar* and *Seven-Eleven* serial arcs in contiguous order.
serial_continuity.evidenceQuote: "Dedicated to posting complete 5-part Bob Bailey and Mandel Kramer Johnny Dollar serial arcs in sequence."

open_api_export.summary: Open RSS 2.0 podcast feed with direct MP3 URLs, but no relational JSON API or `/llms.txt`.
open_api_export.evidenceQuote: "Standard Podbean RSS 2.0 XML feed accessible to any podcast client or script."

dedup_integrity.summary: Curated single-host feed avoids mass duplicate dumps.

gotchas.title: Narrow Genre Scope (~2,450 Crime/Western Episodes)
gotchas.detail: Covers roughly 2% of surviving OTR broadcasts, omitting comedy, variety, daytime soaps, news, and prestige drama anthologies.
